evidence.repeatedViews: stable owned-resource count over3 Escape/reopen cycles
evidence.lifecycle: synthetic persisted pagehide closes cards/releases all resources; pageshow restores ready without opening cards
evidence.focus: disable to Settings then Escape returns to visible Settings button
evidence.preferences: explicit on persists reload; off persists reload
evidence.fullCoreOffOnOff: actual opening, second gathering, civic event and film complete3times; relevant outcomes exactly equal, player coordinates excluded

evidence.lateLoads: completion under Neighbors cannot replace dialog/focus; disabling pending fetch leaves no cards/resources/core change

evidence.lifecycleFailure: synthetic persisted pagehide/pageshow preserves error without new request; error-stub disable then close focuses Settings
evidence.badExport: missing activate export is contained; explicit retry imports fresh URL and succeeds

evidence.stalledLoad: 10second host deadline aborts load, releases resources, and allows explicit off

evidence.syntheticMarkup: organization text is rendered literally, no image/script/event executes and no external resource request

evidence.measurement: HTMLAudio pause command/state within100ms with throwing cleanup; main local audio continues. Synthetic QA tone only, not shipped voices or acoustic speaker latency certification.

limits: Automated Chrome/touch emulation; no physical phone, full screen reader, human pacing, real service availability, actual voice recording or acoustic-latency certification.
